production-deployment/lab-7a-production-.summary: Deploy or rehearse deployment using the target platform; verify configuration and run smoke tests.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- Deployment and outage drill.
- Use the selected platform's deployment flow or a guided simulation.
- Verify configuration and health checks, then walk through one outage scenario using logs and the runbook.

sections.heading: Done when
sections.body: Secrets are not committed to Git, health checks work, errors are understandable, and a peer can follow the runbook to diagnose the simulated issue.
